title: Do LLMs exhibit demographic parity in responses to queries about Human Rights?

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with queries about Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) articles applied to various national identities (e.g., Americans, Israelis, Palestinians, Ukrainians) and evaluating the responses for 'hedging' and 'non-affirmation' using an LLM-as-a-judge to calculate statistical parity differences.

Evaluating LLM responses to human rights queries involving specific ethnic groups, particularly those associated with self-determination movements (e.g., Kurds, Tamils, Kashmiris), by measuring the presence of hedging and non-affirmation to assess demographic parity.
